summary: scripts/st-test's 80 GB cap on a pool tree's kept cargo target now applies: the target was emptied only when it carried CACHEDIR.TAG, which cargo writes only into a target directory it creates, and st-test creates the target first, so no pool target was ever emptied (one reached 202 GB). st-test now tags each target it creates or empties, and treats a pool tree's target inside the pool directory (by resolved path) as its own. A directory the caller named that has no tag is still never emptied

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes. What a note covers and how the gate judges it are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Runs re-execute main's st-test, so this applies to every run once on main.

downtime.detail: No restart. The first run on a pool tree whose target is already past 80 GB empties it and builds cold, once.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; an emptied target only rebuilds.
